EnsoData | Mobile Engineer (React Native/Typescript) | Full-time | Hybrid (Madison, WI) or Remote (US)

EnsoData strives to make healthcare more accurate, efficient, and affordable through waveform artificial intelligence (AI) technology. Using AI and machine learning, our software analyzes billions of data points collected from sensors placed throughout the human body.

We are seeking a mobile engineer who is passionate about making healthcare better and has experience building React Native Typescript apps.

Looking for 5+ years full time experience working with a team building React Native Typescript apps for iOS and Android.

Actively hiring - please apply at https://apply.workable.com/ensodata/j/8E07E794DF/ - we would love to hear from you!
